rationale: A static coat retains irregular material detail; role-readable layers remain underneath and around it.

design_guidelines.artistic_direction: A polished shell mosaic with irregular facets and a clean role-coloured contour.
design_guidelines.concept_twist: A familiar armored shell surface is stretched into a continuously growing snake mosaic.
design_guidelines.body_strategy: Large facets reduce to a clear material cue at 4 cells, become legible by 6-7 cells, and x-tile across long turns without covering the head glow.
design_guidelines.asset_strategy: Use one production-quality 64-texel-per-cell coat; its x join must remain visually seamless after every served transformation.

layer_plan: Outline and Body fallback ribbons remain readable without the atlas
Shell coat image tiles across the whole body above Body fallback
Head glow and system core preserve direction

asset_plan.prompt: 1856x64 opaque coat, 29 body cells, x-seamless irregular shell facets several cells wide; no border, vignette, head, tail, text, or background.

risks: Facet clusters may expose a short repeat even after the join passes
